comparison.objective: Deploy a scissor boom under gravity using only its offload sling.
comparison.physical_skill: Sling-mediated support and guided articulated deployment, not adjuster tool use or tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Boom latches at full length, tip remains at least 1 cm above solar cells, then robot releases it. No spec versions are present.
comparison.reason: The load-support and collision-avoidance ability is different from damper commissioning.
